title: VMM 2026 100km Elevation Profile (official static profile)
claims: The current official 100km page displays VMM26_100km-profile-scaled.jpg in its Elevation Profile section; it is a 2,560 × 1,198 static JPG, not a GPX file.
The profile header states 100KM, TOTAL GAIN 5500 M, TIME LIMIT 28 HRS and DISTANCE 101 KM, with START 05:00 and FINISH cut-off 09:00.

The profile marks CP M2 at 6.7, CP M3 at 12.7, WS at 17.7, CP M4 at 23.1, CP Topas at 25.9, WS at 31.0, CP1 at 40.2, WS at 48.4, CP2 at 52.7, CP3 at 60.9, CP4 at 70.3, CP5 at 78.1, WS at 82.9, CP6 at 87.4, CP7 at 93.1, WS at 95.7 and finish at 101 km.

verification.note: 2026-11-22 从当前官方 100km 页 Elevation Profile 段落取得直链并下载读取：2,560 × 1,198、281,861 字节。抬头写 100KM、TOTAL GAIN 5500 M、TIME LIMIT 28 HRS、DISTANCE 101 KM；横轴 0–101 km，纵轴约 800–2,300 m；CP Topas 标 25.9 km，与官方静态地图的 28.6 km 冲突。
